comments:
The closing verses mention 'Jam dbyangs 'od zer mgon po (ID:3893) as the source of the teaching - he could be 'Jam dbyangs shakya gzhon nu (ID:3894), the eighth abbot of the Lower monastery of gSang phu and founder of Tshal Gung thang. Possibly, the expression refers to both the eighth abbot ('jam dbyangs) and the seventh ('od zer mngon po).
See [J4L5X9AG]: 432, n. 58.
name: grags pa rgya mtsho bde legs 'byung gnas
